package entities

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"monorepo/api/internal/ecommerce/enums"
	integrationsenums "monorepo/api/internal/integrations/enums"
	"monorepo/api/internal/shared/entities"
)

type Transaction struct {
	entities.BaseEntity
	TenantID        string
	ExternalID      string
	Platform        integrationsenums.Platform
	StoreID         string
	OrderExternalID string
	AmountCents     int64
	Currency        string
	Fees            json.RawMessage
	TransactionType enums.TransactionType
	Status          enums.TransactionStatus
	ProcessedAt     *time.Time
}

type NewTransactionParams struct {
	TenantID        string
	ExternalID      string
	Platform        integrationsenums.Platform
	StoreID         string
	OrderExternalID string
	AmountCents     int64
	Currency        string
	Fees            json.RawMessage
	TransactionType enums.TransactionType
	Status          enums.TransactionStatus
	ProcessedAt     *time.Time
}

func NewTransaction(params NewTransactionParams) *Transaction {
	return &Transaction{
		BaseEntity:      entities.NewBaseEntity(),
		TenantID:        params.TenantID,
		ExternalID:      params.ExternalID,
		Platform:        params.Platform,
		StoreID:         params.StoreID,
		OrderExternalID: params.OrderExternalID,
		AmountCents:     params.AmountCents,
		Currency:        params.Currency,
		Fees:            params.Fees,
		TransactionType: params.TransactionType,
		Status:          params.Status,
		ProcessedAt:     params.ProcessedAt,
	}
}

type ReconstructTransactionParams struct {
	ID              uuid.UUID
	TenantID        string
	ExternalID      string
	Platform        integrationsenums.Platform
	StoreID         string
	OrderExternalID string
	AmountCents     int64
	Currency        string
	Fees            json.RawMessage
	TransactionType enums.TransactionType
	Status          enums.TransactionStatus
	ProcessedAt     *time.Time
	CreatedAt       time.Time
	UpdatedAt       time.Time
	Version         int
}

func ReconstructTransaction(params ReconstructTransactionParams) *Transaction {
	return &Transaction{
		BaseEntity:      entities.ReconstructBaseEntity(params.ID, params.CreatedAt, params.UpdatedAt, params.Version),
		TenantID:        params.TenantID,
		ExternalID:      params.ExternalID,
		Platform:        params.Platform,
		StoreID:         params.StoreID,
		OrderExternalID: params.OrderExternalID,
		AmountCents:     params.AmountCents,
		Currency:        params.Currency,
		Fees:            params.Fees,
		TransactionType: params.TransactionType,
		Status:          params.Status,
		ProcessedAt:     params.ProcessedAt,
	}
}

}
